description:
Network Designer Agent v2 — MPLS/L3VPN Infrastructure Design & Deployment with Google Chat Notifications.

Translates high-level network design intent into VyOS Kubernetes Custom Resource Definitions and deploys changes to the running MPLS/L3VPN topology. Manages physical routers, underlay routing protocols (OSPF, MPLS, LDP), and L3VPN services (VRFs, MP-BGP, route targets).
tool_description: Translate high-level network design intent into ordered Kubernetes CRD operations and modify MPLS/L3VPN topologies.
